research_basis.authoring_method: Original synthesis using the user brief and the THE DMI implementation reference as the structural benchmark.
research_basis.licence_handling: Original implementation content informed by Jisc AI maturity structure. Scenarios and practitioner language are independently written to avoid reproducing Jisc wording.

objects.stem: Your institution is dealing with the following situation: leaders responding to widespread AI use without a shared institutional direction. Which next step best reflects stronger AI Strategy & Leadership?

response_options.text: Allow promising AI activity to keep growing locally and wait for successful pilots to prove which practices deserve attention.
response_options.nuisance_reason: Pilot growth alone does not create coordinated development.

response_options.text: Put in place shared ownership, support, governance, and repeatable workflows so use can scale responsibly.
Embed decisions into mainstream institutional planning, monitoring, and lifecycle management across the organisation.

objects.discrimination_notes: This scenario isolates the ED boundary in AI Strategy & Leadership by contrasting a lower-side response, the threshold response, and a higher-side or overshoot response.
objects.authoring_note: Original scenario content written for this implementation.
